articles.title: Craig Bellamy says his loyalty to Wales is unquestionable after rejecting Burnley
articles.summary: Staying with Wales over Burnley a ‘simple choice’ Never claiming expenses cited as a show of commitment. Craig Bellamy said Wales supporters should never question his commitment to the cause after he rejected the chance to manage Burnley, pointing to how he got solicitors’ letters to play for his…
body: Bellamy held talks with Burnley in the summer after the Championship club triggered a release clause in his contract but turned down the move because Wales was “the right place for me”.

He spent two years on the staff of Burnley, working as an assistant to Vincent Kompany and taking caretaker charge after the Belgian left for Bayern Munich, describing those years as “heaven”, but declined the chance to succeed Scott Parker.

His immediate focus is on Nations League matches against Portugal, Denmark and Norway, the first of which is in Lisbon a week on Thursday. Bellamy said Burnley’s interest posed a quandary but that it was ultimately a “simple” decision to stay with Wales, for whom he made 78 appearances as a forward and is under contract until the end of Euro 2028.

articles.title: Max Dowman doubles up for Arsenal’s back-ups to beat Ipswich in Carabao Cup
articles.summary: The bad news for everyone else is that Arsenal’s next generation is already here. Two mesmerising goals in a man-of-the-match display from Max Dowman underlined why the 16-year-old has been compared to a certain Lionel Messi by his manager, Mikel Arteta, as Ipswich were swatted aside with ease.
body: Ipswich won here the last time these two sides met in this competition, in 2011, but were beaten 3-0 in the second leg of the semi-final at the Emirates before Arsenal infam­ously lost to Birmingham in the final. ­Fifteen years on, Gary O’Neil’s heavily rotated side stood no chance against last year’s runners up after Dowman’s brilliant opening goal. Noni Madueke and the stand-in skipper Mikel Merino were also on target as Arsenal made it seven wins out of seven to start the new campaign. Having finally ended their long wait for silverware in style, this team are hungry for more and know they can now rely on one of the most exciting talents ever to have emerged from their Hale End academy.

“He can deliver those actions effortlessly. That’s his biggest quality,” said Arteta of the delightful shimmy that preceded Dowman’s first goal. “It’s a joy to have him. But what we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context. We really need to make sure every time we throw him in, he’s in the right context with the right ­preparation. That’s what we are ­trying to do.”

articles.title: Brook likened to Pietersen in SL win - how do they compare?
articles.summary: Harry Brook hits a brutal century and draws comparisons with Kevin Pietersen as England thrash Sri Lanka by 119 runs in the first T20 in Southampton.
body: The sensational Brook, after a summer without a Test hundred, crashed the ball to all parts in hitting 114 not out from 49 balls to power his side to 254-4.
His 10 fours and six sixes were ferocious - reminiscent of former England batter Pietersen, the newest addition to this side's backroom staff.
"I don't even think the genius of KP could come close to what Harry Brook has talent-wise," said Brook's former captain and team-mate Ben Stokes, who was watching on TV.
Brook was six years old when Pietersen - a shock appointment as a mentor through to next year's World Cup - secured England the Ashes on the final day at The Oval in 2005.

body: Alexis Mac Allister, for the second midweek running, Cody Gakpo and the substitute Dominik Szoboszlai each produced an outstanding finish – especially Szoboszlai – as Liverpool advanced into round four. Spurs had moments but fleeting moments are not enough.

There was no surprise in Andoni Iraola ringing the changes following Saturday’s drab draw with Fulham, especially after he admitted that his team lacked freshness after the Champions League defeat of Atlético Madrid, although 10 raised a few eyebrows. Ronald Araújo was the only player to keep his place in the starting lineup in a new central defensive partnership alongside Joe Gomez, who made his first start of the season. articles.title: Oscar Bobb takes Fulham past stubborn West Ham and into Carabao Cup last 16
articles.summary: Álvaro Arbeloa played in some great defences but whether he knows how to coach one remains to be seen. ­Fulham have been fragile since appointing the Spaniard and they were fortunate not to be dragged into a penalty shootout by West Ham as this entertainingCarabao Cup tie drew to a close.
body: West Ham equalised twice during the first half and they almost did it again after Oscar Bobb made it 3-2 in the 78th minute. Nuno Espírito Santo raged at a poor miss from Taty ­Castellanos, though, and Fulham clambered into the last 16 after resisting late pressure from the ­Championship pacesetters.

It was a mixed bag as far as ­Fulham were concerned. West Ham were beaten but not outplayed and will not mind switching focus back to their promotion push. They stretched Fulham. Arbeloa played an experimental lineup and the performance was not convincing. César Palacios finished with a goal and an assist but Kevin and Emile Smith Rowe disappointed and the Premier League side needed Bobb and Josh King to make the difference after coming off the bench.

“I was a bit upset at half-time,” Arbeloa said. “I am asking how we can concede these two goals. So easy for me. We need to improve there. We need to be more aggressive when defending. In the end we need a massive save. If we are not aggressive enough it is my job to improve my players. We have to work a lot.”

articles.title: Vikings' Carson Wentz gets deflating news after stepping in for Kyler Murray
articles.summary: Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here. The Minnesota Vikings pulled off a win over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday, and boy, was it sweet for them.
body: Vikings' Carson Wentz gets deflating news after stepping in for Kyler Murray originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.

Minnesota won 39-22 over Green Bay, and that was largely without their starting quarterback, Kyler Murray. That's because Murray exited the game during the first quarter after suffering a concussion, and it's not certain when he'll be back.
With Murray out, Carson Wentz stepped in. So, Wentz helped pull off that incredible win. One might think that means Wentz could earn the starting role at Minnesota, but not so fast.

According to Ian Rapoport, Wentz likely won't get the nod to start, at least anytime soon. Speaking on "The Pat McAfee Show," the NFL insider says that Murray will likely get lots of time to prove himself with the Vikings when he comes back.

articles.title: Brook, Buttler go berserk again as England thrash Sri Lanka in first T20
articles.summary: ​​Harry Brook and Jos Buttler went berserk in a T20 at Southampton for the second time this summer as England smoked 254-4 against Sri Lanka during a 119-run victory in the series opener - their first game since Kevin Pietersen's appointment as white-ball mentor.
body: White-ball captain Brook (114no off 49 balls) - who nailed six boundaries in one over - and predecessor in that role Buttler (80 off 49) plundered 128 from just 60 balls in partnership for England's second wicket once debutant Aneurin Donald (12 off 5) fell after slamming a six and a four amid a bright but fleeting cameo.

Brook and Buttler had combined for a riotous stand of 233 from 103 balls at the same venue in July as England romped to a total of 257-3 against India that secured a 4-0 series sweep, with Buttler tonking a century on that occasion and Brook an unbeaten 95.
Watch Thursday's second T20 in Cardiff live on Sky Sports Cricket and Sky Sports Main Event from 6pm (6.30pm first ball).

This time around the roles were reversed with Buttler - playing his first innings since the Hundred final at Lord's on August 16 - missing out on a ton but Brook reaching three figures for the second time in T20 internationals, doing so from just 42 deliveries.

articles.title: Tottenham downed by Liverpool’s second-stringers to reveal painful regret
articles.summary: Liverpool 3-1 Tottenham: Andoni Iraola made 10 changes but his side were still able to progress in the Carabao Cup as Cody Gakpo, a Spurs target in the summer, contributed to their downfall
body: If Tottenham had their way, Cody Gakpo would have been scoring goals for them by now. Instead, he scored against them and even as they ended one barren streak, another looks set to continue.

It was quintessential Gakpo, in the manner of the goal, the right-footed finish angled across the goalkeeper. More pertinently, it felt typical Tottenham. A hideous start to the season was compounded as a club without domestic silverware for 18 years were eliminated from one of the two competitions they could have designs on winning. They have had few returns on their colossal spending spree but suffered at the hands of the man they tried to buy.

articles.title: Lincoln win at Bristol City to haunt old boss Skubala
articles.summary: Bristol City boss Michael Skubala suffered defeat at the hands of his former club as Freddie Draper's second-half goal proved enough to give Lincoln a 1-0 Championship victory.
body: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Bristol City and Lincoln City at Ashton Gate on Tuesday night; Freddie Draper nets as Imps win at new home of their old boss Michael Skubala.
The decisive moment came on 53 minutes when Ben House intercepted Rob Dickie's miscued back-pass, which left goalkeeper Sam Tickle stranded, and set up Draper to shoot into an unguarded net.
The home side fought hard to level but Lincoln, promoted under Skubala last season, defended strongly to show how well they have adapted to life at the higher level.

Bristol City gave a home debut to 22-year-old Dutch midfielder Gibson Yah as one of three changes to the team beaten 4-1 at Southampton, while Lincoln made five changes from their 1-0 victory at Preston including a first League start for Chiedozie Ogbene supporting lone striker Draper.

articles.title: Middlesbrough battle back for point but miss chance to go top
articles.summary: Middlesbrough missed out on the chance to climb to the top of the Sky Bet Championship despite coming from behind to earn a 2-2 draw with Millwall.
body: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Middlesbrough and Millwall at the Riverside Stadium on Tuesday night; Amario Cozier-Duberry and Will Lankshear score as Boro fight back for a point, but they miss the chance to go top of the table.
The Lions deservedly led by two goals at the break after capitalising on Boro's unconvincing start.
Strike duo Tairyk Arconte and Lyndon Dykes put Millwall in the driving seat after finding the net in the 11th and 36th minutes respectively.
But Middlesbrough, who controlled possession for most of the game, recovered to claim a point after head coach Kim Hellberg made three changes at half-time.
